arxiv-2111-01436.title: Learning Size and Shape of Calabi-Yau Spaces
arxiv-2111-01436.creator: Magdalena Larfors, Andre Lukas, Fabian Ruehle, Robin Schneider
arxiv-2111-01436.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Magdalena Larfors, Andre Lukas, Fabian Ruehle, Robin Schneider. We present a new machine learning library for computing metrics of string compactification spaces. We benchmark the performance on Monte-Carlo sampled integrals against previous numerical approximations and find that our neural networks are more sample- and computation-efficient.

arxiv-2311-04639.title: Initial Stages of Water Absorption on 𝐂𝐞𝐎 2 \mathbf{CeO}_{2} Surfaces at Very Low Temperatures for Understanding Anti-Icing Coatings
arxiv-2311-04639.creator: A C Åsland, S P Cooil, D Mamedov, H I Røst, J Bakkelund, Z Li, S Karazhanov, J W Wells
arxiv-2311-04639.description: Abstract Anti-icing coatings are intended to prevent ice formation on surfaces, minimising the risk of surface-related damage and also reducing ice-related hazards in society. CeO 2 \mathrm{CeO}_{2} coatings are robust, hydrophobic, and transmit light, thus they are suitable for a range of applications.

arxiv-2407-14997.title: Improving Citation Text Generation: Overcoming Limitations in Length Control
arxiv-2407-14997.creator: Biswadip Mandal, Xiangci Li, Jessica Ouyang
arxiv-2407-14997.description: Abstract A key challenge in citation text generation is that the length of generated text often differs from the length of the target, lowering the quality of the generation. While prior works have investigated length-controlled generation, their effectiveness depends on knowing the appropriate generation length.

arxiv-2408-08335.title: Plan with Code: Comparing approaches for robust NL to DSL generation
arxiv-2408-08335.creator: Nastaran Bassamzadeh, Chhaya Methani
arxiv-2408-08335.description: Abstract Planning in code is considered a more reliable approach for many orchestration tasks. This is because code is more tractable than steps generated via Natural Language and make it easy to support more complex sequences by abstracting deterministic logic into functions.

arxiv-2412-07872.title: Evaluating the Potential of Federated Learning for Maize Leaf Disease Prediction
arxiv-2412-07872.creator: Thalita Mendonça Antico 1, Larissa F. Rodrigues Moreira 2, Rodrigo Moreira 1
arxiv-2412-07872.description: Abstract The diagnosis of diseases in food crops based on machine learning seemed satisfactory and suitable for use on a large scale. The Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) perform accurately in the disease prediction considering the image capture of the crop leaf, being extensively enhanced in the literature.

arxiv-2504-02840.title: Statistical applications of the 20/60/20 rule in risk management and portfolio optimization
arxiv-2504-02840.creator: Kewin Pączek ∗, Damian Jelito ∗, Marcin Pitera ∗, Agnieszka Wyłomańska †
arxiv-2504-02840.description: Abstract . This paper explores the applications of the 20/60/20 rule—a heuristic method that segments data into top-performing, average-performing, and underperforming groups—in mathematical finance. We review the statistical foundations of this rule and demonstrate its usefulness in risk management and portfolio optimization. Our study highlights three key applications.

pmc-12439517.title: Diagnosing Oligoarticular Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis in a Two-Year-Old: A Case Report
pmc-12439517.creator: Peter Richa, Matthew Thomas, Olivia Keller, Skye Karastury, Madhura Butala
pmc-12439517.description: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) is a rare heterogeneous group of autoimmune disorders presenting in children and is characterized by persistent joint inflammation without a known cause. Here, we present the clinical course of a two-year-old girl who developed acute right knee swelling without preceding trauma.

pmc-12597297.title: Stereo-EEG associated anti-GAD65 autoimmune encephalitis – A report of two cases
pmc-12597297.creator: Claude Steriade, Andrew Christiana, Giovanna Dane, Peter A. Rozman, Daniel Friedman
pmc-12597297.description: Highlights•SEEG can be followed by a subacute encephalopathy with GAD intrathecal synthesis.•An autoimmune workup should be considered prior to SEEG in TLE of unknown cause.•SEEG may induce autoimmune encephalitis through BBB disruption in prone individuals. Introduction Autoimmune encephalitis (AE) has been increasingly recognized as an uncommon cause of seizures that holds the potential for etiology-targeted immunotherapy, if identified early.

pmc-12613339.title: Association between depression symptoms at the early stage of ART treatment and the likelihood of becoming pregnant: a prospective cohort study
pmc-12613339.creator: July Khin Maung Soe, Stuart Gilmour, Makiko Sampei, Kazuki Saito, Kevin Y. Urayama, Tsuguhiko Kato
pmc-12613339.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposePrevious studies have shown that receiving Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatment can affect women’s mental health negatively. Using prospective cohort data of women undergoing ART treatment in Japan, we investigated the associations of depression symptoms at the early stage of ART treatment with (1) the likelihood of achieving pregnancy and (2) depression symptoms at the time of reporting pregnancy during the follow-up period.MethodsOur analysis included 338 women.

pmc-12951871.title: Inhalable Albumin Nanoparticles Co-Delivering Dihydroartemisinin and Nintedanib Attenuate Pulmonary Fibrosis by Suppressing TGF-β1/Smad2/3 Signaling
pmc-12951871.creator: Caopei Zheng, Wei Ding, Yuqing Sun, Yu Wang, Yulin Zhang
pmc-12951871.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposePulmonary fibrosis (PF) is a progressive interstitial lung disease characterized by high morbidity and limited treatment options. Current antifibrotic agents, such as pirfenidone and nintedanib (NIN), are restricted by systemic toxicity and insufficient pulmonary targeting. This study aimed to develop an inhalable human serum albumin (HSA)-based nanoparticle system co-delivering NIN and dihydroartemisinin (DHA), termed DHA/NIN@HSA, to achieve efficient lung-targeted combinational therapy against PF.MethodsDHA/NIN@HSA nanoparticles were prepared via a self-assembly strategy and characterized for morphology, particle size, and drug-loading efficiency.

pmc-13179142.title: ATOX1 alleviates radiation‐induced cardiac injury by modulating AMPK/NRF2 to inhibit myocardial oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction
pmc-13179142.creator: Wen Deng, Li Su
pmc-13179142.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Radiation‐induced heart disease (RIHD) is a myocardial lesion caused by radiation exposure, and its pathogenesis is closely associated with oxidative stress. ATOX1 has been demonstrated to regulate oxidative stress, but its mechanism in RIHD remains unclear. We analyzed ATOX1 expression (Western blot [WB], RT‐PCR), cardiomyocyte proliferation (MTT, IF), apoptosis (TUNEL), AMPK signaling (WB, IF), and mitochondrial function (reactive oxygen species [ROS], mPTP, JC‐1) in vitro. A thoracic irradiation model was used in cardiomyocyte‐specific ATOX1 knockout mice.

pmc-13409630.title: AI-Assisted Forensic Analysis of Hanging-Related Ligature Marks: A Pilot Study Using Convolutional Neural Networks
pmc-13409630.creator: Giorgia Rigano, Fabrizio De Vita, Lucia Candela, Dario Bruneo, Salvatore De Caro, Marija Čaplinskienė, Elvira Ventura Spagnolo, Gennaro Baldino
pmc-13409630.description: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied in medical image analysis, although its application in forensic pathology remains limited. The assessment of ligature marks in hanging deaths is challenging and relies on forensic expertise. This pilot study evaluated a deep learning approach for morphological classification of hanging-related ligature marks.

(a) Rules or regulations The President is further authorized to take such other action, including prohibiting or restricting the importation or exportation of wheat or wheat-flour and to issue such rules or regulations which shall have the force and effect of law, as may.
